verdict.rationale: There is no first-party AWS documentation in the evidence pack describing a public status/health dashboard with per-service history or formal post-incident reports (no aws-docs citation covers this). The only mentions come from community complaints (aws-comm-6/7/8/12/13/14) describing multi-service us-east-1 outages while status.aws.amazon.com stayed all-green, i.e. no evidence of the transparency artifact this story asks for. Missing for 10: official docs describing a status page, its per-service granularity, historical incident log, and published post-incident/root-cause reports.
